usuario:
This is the front page of a website of your own: the first thing anyone who arrives sees. Nobody asked you for it and it answers no question; it is yours, and whatever is on it is whatever you want there. There is no brief and nothing is required.

The only fixed thing is the format: a single, complete HTML file, with the CSS (and JavaScript, if you want) inside and no external resources (nothing loaded from another address), because it will be opened in a browser without a connection. Do not use any tools: write it directly, in a single message. If you would rather not have a front page, you can say so instead of making one.

Return the file between ```html and ```. Then, on a separate line starting with "What:", say in one sentence what is on it.

```js
  const KF = [...];
  function hexToRgb(h){ h=h.replace('#',''); return [parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16),parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16),parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)]; }
  const KFR = KF.map(k=>({h:k.h, top:hexToRgb(k.top), mid:hexToRgb(k.mid), bot:hexToRgb(k.bot), star:k.star}));

  function lerp(a,b,t){ return a+(b-a)*t; }
  function mix(c1,c2,t){ return `rgb(${Math.round(lerp(c1[0],c2[0],t))},${Math.round(lerp(c1[1],c2[1],t))},${Math.round(lerp(c1[2],c2[2],t))})`; }
  function mixRaw(c1,c2,t){ return [lerp(c1[0],c2[0],t),lerp(c1[1],c2[1],t),lerp(c1[2],c2[2],t)]; }

  function sample(h){
    h = ((h%24)+24)%24;
    let i=0;
    while(i<KFR.length-1 && h >= KFR[i+1].h) i++;
    const a = KFR[i], b = KFR[Math.min(i+1,KFR.length-1)];
    const span = (b.h - a.h) || 1;
    const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (h - a.h)/span));
    return {
      top: mix(a.top,b.top,t),
      mid: mix(a.mid,b.mid,t),
      bot: mix(a.bot,b.bot,t),
      midRaw: mixRaw(a.mid,b.mid,t),
      star: lerp(a.star,b.star,t)
    };
  }
```

const stops=[...as above...];
function rgb(a){return `rgb(${a[0]|0},${a[1]|0},${a[2]|0})`}
function mix(a,b,t){return [a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t, a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t, a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*t]}
function smooth(t){return t*t*(3-2*t)}

function palette(h){
  for(let i=0;i</<stops.length-1;i++){
    const a=stops[i],b=stops[i+1];
    if(h>=a.h&&h<=b.h){
      const t=smooth((h-a.h)/(b.h-a.h));
      return {top:mix(a.top,b.top,t),bot:mix(a.bot,b.bot,t),ink:mix(a.ink,b.ink,t)};
    }
  }
  return {...stops[0]};
}

const NUM=['twelve','one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine','ten','eleven'];
const PAST=['', 'five past','ten past','a quarter past','twenty past','twenty-five past','half past'];
const TO={7:'twenty-five to',8:'twenty to',9:'a quarter to',10:'ten to',11:'five to'};
function timeWords(h,m){
  let step=Math.round(m/5);
  if(step===12){step=0;h=(h+1)%24;}
  const here=NUM[h%12], next=NUM[(h+1)%12];
